title: Patch: Your Table's showcase animations stay below the homescreen's dividing line
thread:
**Issue #3600 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3600: Patch: Your Table's showcase animations stay below the homescreen's dividing line
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What's wrong

On the homescreen, the animations of the "Your table" stat showcase (R1584000, `apps/web/src/stats/StatShowcase.tsx`) bleed up into the main menu (the hero, `.landing-hero`) above it. The two are meant to be split by the gold rule along the top of the stats section (`.landing .landing-stats`'s `border-top`, `apps/web/src/routes/landing.css`), but the showcase's particles, glows and keyframes draw straight across that line over the menu.

## Likely cause

The showcase mounts the board's effects layer (`<div className="fx-layer">` with its `canvas.fx-canvas` and `div.fx-dom`, `StatShowcase.tsx`). `.fx-layer` (`apps/web/src/fx/fx.css`) is `position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 38`, made for the board, where it covers the whole viewport. On the landing it covers the viewport too, so anything the director draws above the card lands over the hero, and its z-index beats the hero's `z-index: 1`. `.landing-stats` sets no clipping. The card's own `[data-animating]` keyframes from `game/animations.css` (the ones that scale or glow outward) can spill over the line the same way when the section is short (phone landscape, `--showcase-card-w` clamps).

## What to do

- **Keep every animation as it is.** Don't remove, shorten, scale down or turn off any beat, effect or keyframe, and leave the board's `.fx-layer` rules alone (the board needs them full-viewport). The only change is where they get cut off.
- Cut off everything the showcase draws at the top edge of the "Your table" section (the gold dividing line), so nothing paints over the main menu. Anything below the line still draws as now.
- One way: clip the section's painting (e.g. `clip-path: inset(0)` on `.landing .landing-stats`, which also clips fixed-position descendants; `overflow: hidden` doesn't). Or scope a landing-only rule for the showcase's `.fx-layer`. If something makes the layer's containing block the section (`contain: paint`, a transform), check that the effects still land on the card (`fx/anchors.ts` `resolveAnchor`) and that the pixel sizes are unchanged.
- Don't break R2035000: the quests' (and news') parchment from the hero still hangs over the stats on purpose. Clipping the stats section shouldn't touch it, since it belongs to the hero, but check.
- The focus ring on `.landing-showcase[role="button"]` (`outline-offset: 2px`) must still show.

## Acceptance

- [ ] With a game played (so "Your table" shows), scroll so the dividing line is mid-viewport and step through the showcase's stats, the effect-heavy beats among them (a death's burn, a summon, Divine Shield, Freeze). No pixel of the showcase's animation is drawn above the line, and below it they play as before. Check desktop and phone landscape (the `max-height: 500px` layout).
- [ ] A test for it: a vitest in `apps/web/src/stats/StatShowcase.test.tsx` or a landing test asserting the clip on the section, and/or a Cypress component/pixel spec if one covers the landing.
- [ ] Before/after screenshots in the pull request (the `ui-walkthrough` skill).
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web` all green.

## Goal

Fix issue #3600: the "Your table" showcase's animations (particles, glows, card keyframes) must be cut off exactly at the top edge of the `.landing-stats` section (the gold dividing rule), so no pixel paints over the hero menu above, while every animation below the line plays unchanged.

## Files to touch

| File | New/change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/routes/landing.css` | change | Add `clip-path: inset(0);` (+ comment) to the existing `.landing .landing-stats` rule; nothing else in the sheet |
| `apps/web/src/stats/StatShowcase.tsx` | change | Add exported `toLayerBox` helper; wrap the director's `measure: resolveAnchor` so anchors are translated into the layer's box |
| `apps/web/src/stats/StatShowcase.test.tsx` | change | New `describe` block with 5 tests (clip rule, board layer untouched, `toLayerBox`, quests parchment, focus ring) |

Must not touch: `crates/*`, `apps/web/src/fx/fx.css` (board's `.fx-layer` rules), `apps/web/src/game/animations.css` (keyframes/durations), `spec/` + `spec/rulings/` (no new ruling: this is a painting bug, not an undecided rules semantic), `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. Governing spec: R1584000 (showcase), R2035000 (quests parchment), R639 (Your table); R1743000 (showcase control/focus).

## Steps

(Re-read `spec/rulings/R1584000.md`, `spec/rulings/R2035000.md`, and the `--- your table (R639)` block of `landing.css` before each edit.)

1. `apps/web/src/routes/landing.css`, rule `.landing .landing-stats` (~line 969): add `clip-path: inset(0);` as the last declaration with a short comment (R1584000: also clips fixed-position descendants, which `overflow: hidden` does not; R2035000: the quests'/news' parchment belongs to the hero, so it still hangs over). `inset(0)` clips at the border box's outer edge, so the 1px gold `border-top` stays visible and everything above it is cut: card `[data-animating]` spill and the showcase's fixed `.fx-layer` alike. Change no other selector in this sheet.
2. `apps/web/src/stats/StatShowcase.tsx`: `clip-path` on the section makes the section the containing block of the fixed `.fx-layer`, so the layer fills the section and viewport-measured boxes must be translated. Add `import type { FxAnchor, FxBox } from "../fx/types.ts";`, add the exported helper near `NO_SHAKE`: `export function toLayerBox(box: FxBox, origin: { x: number; y: number }): FxBox { return { x: box.x - origin.x, y: box.y - origin.y, width: box.width, height: box.height }; }` (widths/heights untouched, so pixel sizes never change). In `StatStage`'s `createFxDirector` call replace `measure: resolveAnchor` with a closure measuring fresh each cue (scroll-safe): resolve via `resolveAnchor`, return as-is on `null` or when `domRef.current` is `null`, else subtract `domRef.current.getBoundingClientRect()` left/top via `toLayerBox`. Under jsdom both rects are zero, so existing tests see the identity. Confirm by grep that `StatShowcase.tsx` passes no `standIn` to the director, so this wrapper covers every cue path (`director.ts` only bypasses `options.measure` for a stand-in).
3. `apps/web/src/stats/StatShowcase.test.tsx`: follow the `readFileSync(resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url), ...), "landing.css"), "utf8")` pattern from `apps/web/src/routes/landing.test.tsx`. Assert on sheet text (vitest stubs CSS imports): the `.landing .landing-stats` block contains `clip-path: inset(0);`; `fx.css` still contains a `.fx-layer` rule with `position: fixed;` and no `.landing` selector; no `clip-path`/`overflow` added to `.landing-hero`, `.landing-quests-panel`, `.landing-news-panel`; the `.landing .landing-showcase[role="button"]:focus-visible` rule with `outline-offset: 2px` is intact. Unit-test `toLayerBox`: origin `{x:0,y:0}` is the identity; `{x:40,y:150}` maps `{x:100,y:200,width:80,height:112}` to `{x:60,y:50,width:80,height:112}`.
4. Regression runs (sheet + behavior): the full `StatShowcase.test.tsx` file plus `src/routes/landing-quests.test.tsx`, `src/routes/landing-news.test.tsx`, `src/routes/landing.test.tsx`.
5. Walkthrough (`ui-walkthrough` skill, `sh scripts/browse.sh`): serve `pnpm --dir apps/web dev --port 5173 --strictPort`, seed `localStorage jackioh.stats.v1 = {"v":1,"games":12,"wins":7,"losses":5,"draws":0,"cards":{"core-004":{"seen":12,"played":9,"defeated":4}}}`, open `/`, scroll the gold rule mid-viewport, step the showcase through a death burn, a summon, Divine Shield loss and Freeze and screenshot each mid-beat on desktop 1280x720 and phone landscape (~844x390, the `max-height: 500px` layout): no pixel above the line, unchanged below. Focus the showcase by keyboard and screenshot the ring. Save before/after shots under `.cache/browse/` for the PR (never into the repo).

## Tests

- `apps/web/src/stats/StatShowcase.test.tsx`, new `describe("R1584000 the showcase stays below the gold line")`: `it("R1584000 the stats section clips its painting at the gold rule")`, `it("R1584000 the board's effects layer stays viewport-fixed and landing-free")`, `it("R1584000 the layer-relative measure keeps the card's pixels")`, `it("R2035000 the quests' and news' parchment still hangs over the stats")`, `it("R1743000 the showcase keeps its focus ring")`.
- Commands: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/stats/StatShowcase.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/landing-quests.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/landing-news.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/landing.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web`.

## Done when

- [ ] Dividing rule mid-viewport: death burn, summon, Divine Shield, Freeze beats paint nothing above the line, play unchanged below, desktop + phone landscape.
- [ ] Quests'/news' parchment still hangs over the stats; showcase focus ring still shows.
- [ ] No animation, beat, keyframe, duration, `.fx-layer` board rule, or pixel size changed.
- [ ] New vitest block green; regression files green; typecheck + eslint green; before/after walkthrough screenshots attached to the PR.

## Risks

- `clip-path` creates a stacking context on the section (`position: relative`, `z-index: auto`): it still paints below the hero (`z-index: 1` + `isolate`), so the hero and its parchment keep their order; verified by the parchment test + existing quests tests.
- Coordinate shift from the new containing block: neutralized by the per-cue origin subtraction (widths/heights pass through; `capacityFor`/`phone` still use `window.innerWidth`); jsdom identity keeps old tests exact.
- Presentation-only (CLAUDE.md rule 7): no state, no hidden info, no determinism/replay impact; no new numbers (rule 9: `inset(0)` is the border box itself; all timings reused).

## Open questions

None. No new ruling: cutting painting at the section edge decides no game semantic, so no `spec/rulings/R*.md` note, no `proven_in`, no `spec/pending/` paragraph.
```
